blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Lesson 12.4.1's first_calls.py posts {"portfolio": "tiny", "budget": {"2028": 1000}} to POST /plans. What did it print?

options.text: 409 with detail: the 2028 budget is below must-do spend
options.says: The program printed 200; this API answers a scenario with no plan with 200 and a status.

options.text: 200 with status optimal, NPV 2291.0 and four projects started
options.says: The printed status was infeasible: must-do P002 spends $2,730k in 2028.

options.text: 200 with status infeasible, npv None, and empty starts and spend
options.says: Right: the printed reply is 200 {'status': 'infeasible', 'npv': None, 'starts': {}, 'spend': {}}.

options.text: 422 with detail: the 2028 budget is below must-do spend
options.says: The body fit every rule of PlanRequest, so no 422 was printed; the reply was 200.

origin.section: An Infeasible Scenario Is an Answer, Not an HTTP Error

questions.stem: Lesson 12.4.1's bad_requests.py posts a body whose budgets are under the misspelled key "budgets". What did the API answer?

options.text: 200, and the plan was solved on the portfolio's own budgets
options.says: PlanRequest sets extra="forbid", so the misspelled key was refused, not ignored.

options.text: 422 at ['body', 'budget']: Field required, as budget was absent
options.says: budget has a default, so it is not required; the error named the misspelled key.

options.text: 200, and the status was infeasible with no budgets read at all
options.says: No model was built: the body was refused with 422 before the endpoint ran.

options.text: 422 at ['body', 'budgets']: Extra inputs are not permitted
options.says: Right: extra="forbid" refuses an undeclared field, as the printed line shows.

origin.section: The Request Is a Pydantic Model, and FastAPI Refuses What It Does Not Fit

questions.stem: Lesson 12.4.1's openapi_view.py prints PlanRequest as JSON Schema. Besides exclusiveMinimum 0, what does it list for time_limit_s?

options.says: Right: the printed time_limit_s entry is "default": 10.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 60.
The printed schema has "default": 10.0, not 5.0, and "maximum": 60, not 300.
The printed schema has "default": 10.0 and "maximum": 60 for time_limit_s.
The printed schema has "default": 10.0, and 60 is the maximum, not the default.

origin.section: FastAPI Writes the API's Description From the Same Models
